description: This file contains implementation of functions for creating and setting up sparse fully connected (linear) layers specific to quantized neural networks in QNNPACK, a quantized neural network acceleration library used in PyTorch. It defines functions to create a sparse fully connected operator with various parameters and to configure its input, output, and bias for execution.

methods.description: Creates a sparse, quantized fully connected operator with parameters for input/output channels, zero points, kernel data, requantization scales, and configuration flags.
